 How to watch Norway vs Wales
 Date: Saturday, November 14, 2026
 Time: 11:50 AM EDT
 Channel: FOX Sports 2
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Norway hosts Wales on Saturday as the bottom pair in UEFA Nations League Group A4 duke it out at Ullevaal Stadion. The Dragons successfully pacified Erling Haaland en route to a 2-1 win in Cardiff when these teams met for the first time in 15 years last month, but the pressure is considerably higher as the threat of relegation looms even larger for both teams entering Matchday 5.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Several months after reaching the World Cup 2026 quarterfinals, Stale Solbakken's side are now at risk of dropping down a division in the continental competition, having taken just three points from a possible 12 in Group A4 thus far. They sit level on points with Wales for the time being, though Craig Bellamy's men maintain the advantage owing to their win in the Welsh capital last month.
 That edge could dissolve depending on the result this weekend, where both teams will be looking to move level on points with second-place Denmark. Wales has already lost twice to the Danes, meaning it will need Brian Riemer's side to pick up no more wins from their last two games against group leader Portugal and Norway if it's to have a chance of finishing in the top two.
 Norway enters this matchup on the back of three straight defeats, its longest losing streak in a decade, while it hasn't lost two in a row in Oslo since late 2020. Fortune has it that Wales has lost three consecutive road fixtures, however, targeting its first away victory in almost exactly 12 months.
